note: Recorded tool-call shape of fixture-refunds in live run 3 (docs/sota/bench-live-3-2026-11-21.json): the same tools on the same turns, first run_test on turn 13 and both proposals on turn 18. The arguments are written for the harness check, not model output.

arguments.claim: The cap check compares each refund with the whole payment and ignores what was already refunded, so two refunds of 60 on a payment of 100 both succeed.
GET /refunds/{id} checks only that a merchant header is present, so merchant m-2 can read a refund of merchant m-1.

arguments.summary: Two refund findings, each proven by a test.
